description: This file defines a Java interface named LoanDownPaymentHandlerService, which declares methods related to handling loan down payments, repayments, recoveries, or waivers within the loan account service of the Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanDownPaymentHandlerService
classes.description: A Java interface that declares methods for handling down payments, repayments, recoveries, or waivers for loans.

methods.name: handleDownPayment
methods.description: Processes a down payment for a loan, given schedule information, command data, a disbursement transaction, and the loan object.

methods.name: handleRepaymentOrRecoveryOrWaiverTransaction
methods.description: Handles repayment, recovery, or waiver transactions for a loan, including adjustments and schedule updates.
